title: Digging into the Massive Protostar S255IR NIRS3: A Study of Nitrogen-bearing Molecules and Their Prebiotic Chemistry
question: Investigate the rotational emission lines, spatial distributions, abundances, and prebiotic formation chemistry of complex N-bearing molecules toward the high-mass protostar S255IR NIRS3.

data.sensitivity: continuum RMS: 2.35-2.91 mJy; spectral RMS: ~0.05 K

what.value: ALMA Bands 3, 6, and 7 flux densities for SED fitting

evidence.quote: The flux densities for bands 3, 6, and 7 were taken from (cite: ce18), (cite: be23), and (cite: zin20), respectively.

evidence.quote: using the local thermodynamic equilibrium (LTE) model with an optically thin assumption with the JPL, CDMS, and LSD molecular databases

evidence.quote: We compare the abundances of detected N-bearing species in NIRS3 with several hot core and hot corino sources, such as Sgr B2 (N) (cite: bel13), Sgr B2 (M) (cite: bel13; bel16), Orion KL (cite: fri08; lo14; mot12; bell14; pen17; pag17), G31.41+0.31 (cite: min23; wy99; man24c), G10.47+0.03 (cite: rof11; han14), IRAS 16293–2422 B (cite: cou18; cal18), IRAS 4A2 (cite: lo17; bel20), and IRAS 2A1 (cite: bel20).

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image ALMA Band 4 continuum and spectral line cubes
recipe.method: Run ALMA calibration pipeline with Perley-Butler 2017 flux scale, flag bad data, split target with MSTRANSFORM, subtract continuum with UVCONTSUB, image continuum and cubes with TCLEAN, apply self-calibration (GAINCAL/APPLYCAL), and correct primary beam with IMPBCOR.
key_parameters: deconvolver = HOGBOM, specmode = cube, Briggs weighting = 0.5

recipe.goal: Measure continuum flux density, peak intensity, and core size, and model radial intensity profile
recipe.method: Fit 2D Gaussian to continuum images at 4 frequencies using IMFIT; construct radial profile at 2.32 mm in 0.1'' concentric annuli and fit 5 analytical models (Single Power-law, Single Plummer, Broken Power-law, Double Plummer, Plummer + Gaussian).

recipe.goal: Fit the multi-wavelength SED to derive dust mass, dust temperature, and dust spectral index
recipe.method: Combine ALMA Band 3, 4, 6, 7 continuum fluxes with AKARI, Herschel, and Spitzer/IRAC upper limits (3.6 to 500 um) and fit radiative transfer model using MCMC.
assumptions: Source distance fixed at 1.78 kpc; AKARI, Herschel, and Spitzer/IRAC fluxes treated as upper limits

recipe.goal: Estimate H2 column density and dust optical depth and model 3D radiative transfer maps
recipe.method: Compute H2 column density and dust optical depth analytically from peak continuum flux densities at four wavelengths assuming optically thin dust, and simulate 2D maps using RADMC-3D (image, mctherm, tausurf tasks).
key_parameters: n_photons = 3x10^8, r_in = 20 AU, r_out = 4.5x10^3 AU, r_plat = 900 AU, p_env = 1.1
assumptions: Optically thin dust continuum; T_d = 150 K; mean molecular weight mu_H = 1.41; dust-to-gas ratio Z = 0.01; dust opacity kappa_nu = 0.90(nu/230 GHz)^beta cm^2 g^-1 with beta = 1.7

recipe.goal: Extract molecular spectra and perform LTE MCMC spectral modelling to derive column densities, excitation temperatures, and abundances
recipe.method: Extract spectra from a 2.32'' diameter circular region centered on NIRS3; identify transitions using JPL, CDMS, and LSD databases; fit optically thin LTE models using MCMC in CASSIS; divide column densities by N(H2), N(CH3OH), and N(CH3CN) to obtain fractional abundances.
key_parameters: Aperture diameter = 2.32''; source size = 2.32''; V_LSR = 5.0 km s^-1; 1000 walkers; 20,000 burn-in steps
assumptions: LTE and optically thin emission; CMB temperature = 2.7 K

recipe.goal: Generate moment-zero maps and measure spatial emitting regions of N-bearing species
recipe.method: Create integrated intensity (moment zero) maps using CASA IMMOMENTS over line channel ranges and fit 2D Gaussians using IMFIT to derive emitting region sizes.

recipe.goal: Compute Pearson correlation coefficients across sources and compare abundances with three-phase warm-up astrochemical models
recipe.method: Calculate Pearson r correlation matrices for molecular abundances relative to CH3OH and excitation temperatures across 9 hot core/corino sources; compare NIRS3 abundances against three-phase warm-up chemical models (Models A and B, plus literature models).
key_parameters: Pearson correlation threshold r = 0.7; sample size n = 9 sources
